task_completion.visual_evidence: A green-colored shape containing the text 'Service Restored' or similar wording indicating the end of the incident.

task_completion.description: The diagram is exported as a PDF to the specified exports folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the diagrams.net GUI to create the diagram rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the draw.io canvas, dragging shapes, or using the color picker.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file or copy a pre-made image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the diagram being built step-by-step (adding shapes, typing text, connecting arrows).

integrity.description: The timestamps and event descriptions match the provided incident_log.txt.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text inside the diagram shapes matches the specific timestamps found in the log (e.g., 23:27 for rm -rf, 18:14 for restoration).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The incident log contains 8 events. Key events for verification: [23:27] is the 'rm -rf' event (must be red and a special shape like a star/cloud/callout); [18:14] (next day) is 'Service Restored' (must be green).
